newsitem.title: ITALY: Specialists bid for 184 bln lire of Italy BTPs.
newsitem.headline: Specialists bid for 184 bln lire of Italy BTPs.

text.p: Specialist bond traders bid for and were allocated 184 billion lire of 10-year fixed-rate bonds (BTP) against the Italian Treasury's offer of 200 billion lire of paper.
Earlier, the Treasury received bids for 3.176 trillion lire at the open auction for the November 1, 2006 paper, against 2.0 trillion lire worth of bonds on offer.
The auction price was set at 104.05 from 104.60 at the previous BTP sale on November 15. Gross yield was 7.29 percent against 7.22 percent.
